title: VS-Heads
description: A simple Minecraft plugin that allows players to give themselves player heads.
body:
## 🔵 DESCRIPTION
A simple player head plugin.
## 🔵 FEATURES
- Gives players heads using a username or value codes
- Intuitive in-game configuration GUI
- Custom GUI layout configurable in files
- Custom messages configurable in files
- Custom head names and lore configurable in files
- Support for **CustomModelData**
- Formatting support: **MiniMessage (Adventure API)**
## 🔵 PERMISSIONS
- **vs_heads.admin** » Access to all plugin commands and features
- **vs_heads.command.reload** » Access to the /heads reload command
- **vs_heads.command.settings** » Access to the /heads settings command
- **vs_heads.command.give** » Access to the /heads give command
## 🔵 COMMANDS
- **/heads reload** » Reloads the configuration without restarting the server
- **/heads settings** » Opens a user-friendly in-game settings GUI
- **/heads give <player|value> <player|value>** » Gives the head of a selected player or value code
- **/heads give <player|value> <player|value> <player>** » Gives head to the named player
## 🔵 BUG REPORTS
If you found a bug or need help with the configuration, join our Discord server.
